label: Measured graphify retrieval arm on zonoid code nav corpus evidence chunk 1
title: Measured graphify retrieval arm on zonoid code nav corpus evidence chunk 1
summary: Installed graphify (PyPI `graphifyy` v0.8.45, CLI `graphify`) on Windows and ran its retrieval arm over the same 13-query code-nav corpus as the other arms. RESULT: graphify mean_recall 0.436 @ mean_tokens 1362 (ceil chars/4), 6/13 queries hit; mean tok-per-correct 532 (hit queries), aggregate tok/correct 1107. COMPARISON (same scoring contract: whole-word case-insensitive symbol match, ceil(chars/4) tokens, recall=correct/relevant): naive 0.321 @ 3026 (7/13, recomputed from results.jsonl as 0.3205/3025.7 — matches); subconscious/live-KB 0.045 @ 580 (2/13); codebase-memory-mcp 0.506 @ 327. So graphify lands BETWEEN naive and cmm on recall, ~2.2x cheaper than naive on tokens but ~4x more expensive than cmm; cmm dominates graphify on both axes (higher recall AND fewer tokens). Per-query: graphify scored recall 1.0 on q01 (worktree/branch), q04 (embed/cosine), q08 (merge-abort), q09 (search context compiler), q11 (ask-gate recall), and 0.667 on q06 (economy). It scored 0.0 on q02/q03/q05/q07/q10/q12/q13.
